name: app-black-gloved-hands-holding-dark-review-app
title: Gloved Hands Holding Dark Review App
whatItIs: A dark cover with black-gloved hands holding a phone showing a location reviews app with teal highlights, faint grid, and a small meta block (platform, category, role) at top right.
whatItMeans: Everything is black-on-black with one teal glow, giving a sleek, stealthy, premium feel. The metadata row reads like a spec plate.
techniques: Render hands in the same black as the background so only the glowing screen stands out
Teal glow as the only colour
Faint background grid for a technical feel
Small metadata columns in a corner

vocabulary.definition: Using near-identical dark values to hide everything but the focal point.
Small labeled fields listing platform, category and role.
Light emanating from a device display.
